notes.title: Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli – Official Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
The wait is almost over. Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli officially launches on April 14, 2025!

Prepare to uncover the secrets of Darski High School, face terrifying foes, and survive the relentless pursuit of Big Marina. Outsmart deadly teachers, solve intricate puzzles, and brace yourself for an intense final battle against Luli himself.

Are you ready to face the Sacred Protein’s curse? Your nightmare begins April 14th.
